name: earshot
description: A podcast theme for Vuuut. The newest episode plays from the homepage, every episode is drawn to its length, and listeners pick up where they left off.

color_scheme.description: Where every reader starts. Each can switch with the light/dark button in the header.

cover_art.description: Square show artwork, 1400 px or larger: the image podcast apps show. Falls back to the site icon.

apple_podcasts_url.description: Link to the show on Apple Podcasts.

spotify_url.description: Link to the show on Spotify.

youtube_url.description: Link to the show's YouTube channel or playlist.

podcast_rss_url.description: The RSS feed from your podcast host. Listeners copy it into any other podcast app.

number_episodes.description: Numbers posts in publishing order. Turn off if you also publish posts that aren't episodes.

signup_heading.description: Heading of the email signup box. Defaults to "Get new episodes by email".

signup_text.description: One line under the signup heading. Defaults to a line about how often you'll email.

show_about_section.description: Shows your cover art, description, hosts and listening links under the newest episode.

show_start_here.description: Lists your featured episodes as the place new listeners should start.

show_episode_art.description: Shows each episode's feature image beside it in episode lists.

show_chapters.description: Turns lines in show notes that start with a timestamp (04:12 Intro) into chapters.

show_host_card.description: Shows each host's photo and bio after the show notes.

show_related_episodes.description: Shows three more episodes on the same topic after the show notes.
